svg.aria-label: geozl compresses a raster tile through a graph of codecs. Five of the graphs that profile proposes are shown in turn, sharing one rail and differing in which predictor sits on it, which backend closes it, and whether a nodata or a quantizer node is wrapped in front.
svg.title: The graphs geozl profile proposes

g.text: a frame carries the graph that decodes it
